risks.risk: The computer may not be the claimed model (HP Pro 3400)
risks.proof: Photo of the system label or service tag inside the case, or a clear shot of the model name on the front or rear.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic HP desktop, not as Pro 3400, which may reduce value.

risks.risk: The CPU may not be an Intel Core i3
risks.proof: Photo of the CPU sticker or BIOS screen showing CPU model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown CPU, which may reduce value significantly.

risks.risk: The HDD may not be 500GB or may be faulty
risks.proof: Photo of the drive label or BIOS screen showing drive size and health.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown storage, possibly as not working or smaller capacity.

risks.risk: RAM may be less than 4GB or faulty
risks.proof: Photo of RAM sticks or BIOS screen showing installed RAM.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown RAM, possibly as 2GB or not working.

risks.risk: The unit may not power on or have functional components
risks.proof: Video clip showing the unit powering on, BIOS screen, and booting into OS.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which drastically reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo of the system label or service tag inside the case to confirm model.
Photo or video of the BIOS screen showing CPU, RAM, and drive details.
Video clip showing the unit powering on and booting into an operating system.
Photo of the internal drives and RAM sticks if possible.
response.reason: The model name is not visible in photos and must be confirmed. Key specs (CPU, RAM, HDD) are unverifiable without internal access or BIOS proof. Without proof of functionality and exact specs, the item cannot be priced accurately and carries high risk of being misrepresented.
